output.reason: [ev-67a96855ff1b] is only a PR title: "move crd view rbac rules to provider system role". It names no RBAC verbs, so "customresourcedefinitions/view" uses a verb ("view") that is not in the text. It also does not say which role the rules were moved from. Without that, we can't tell whether the change is a relocation that keeps behaviour the same, a grant added to the provider system role, or a removal from another role, so neither the subject identity nor the change type is settled. To decide, we need the content of PR #6677 or an upgrade note naming the role, the resource, the verbs and the before/after binding.
